comment: Ratchet floor, not a target. The frontend suite reports a small, environment-dependent coverage spread for identical code: 960/5191 statements locally and on some runners, 965-966/5191 on others (18.49%-18.6% statements, 32.55%-32.99% branches). The floor is set below the low end of that band so the gate only fires on a real regression. Raise it deliberately when coverage improves; see next_statement_target.
